\caption{Top ten contrastive caption words for every learned dimension, as shown in the word clouds. For each dimension, the 20 words most over-represented in the captions of its 8 highest- vs 8 lowest-activating videos (smoothed log-ratio weighted by log frequency, averaged over 200 random tie-breaks of the two groups) were drawn as a word cloud with size proportional to log-ratio; listed are the ten largest, in order of log-ratio. Subscripts give part of speech (N noun, V verb, Adj adjective, Adv adverb, O other); POS columns give each part of speech's share of the listed words' contrast. JS: Jensen--Shannon divergence (bits) between the caption word distributions of the two groups. Dimensions are ordered by greedy forward selection on the training RSM; the first 11 are those retained by the Kneedle elbow.}\label{tab:contrastive_top10_all_cloudmatched}\\
